dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis? I understand. Does your little one back home also want a Rex Lapis-themed toy?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Have a look: dragon horn tops, stone dice, a dragon-shaped wooden sword, a kite with Rex Lapis' portrait on it... which would you like?

dialogues.speaker: Granny Shan
dialogues.text: Ah... So you're just asking around. I see. Rex Lapis-themed toys are so very popular among the children, so I naturally thought that...
